points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight historical case packages pass structural validator, with genuine output histories and fields. Re200 has 14 inner iterations below required minimum and no supported periodic shedding; restart lacks full transient state.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only validator passes all eight original historical packages and report. Validator is structural and does not establish contour fidelity or numerical convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady runs marked converged use disclosed plateau logic; some force oscillations/drift remain. Re200 reaches t=300 but the periodic-success status is unsupported by the history.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Many forces are bounded, but Re20 has strong unphysical oscillation, M0.15 inviscid Cd varies substantially and Re200 lift is broadband without a supported coherent shedding period.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical 42-page PDF contains case histories and fields, but all 16 reproduced Mach/pressure figures misassign quad values and Re200 vorticity uses cell velocities indexed by node ID; its force plot hides the late interval.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Historical PDF provides methods, case numeric tables and honest discussion of broadband/plateau limitations; numerical figure mapping is invalid and the Re200 claimed periodic state is not supported.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original figure manifest and VTUs/CSVs survived in historical commit, and source-generated figures reproduce byte-for-byte. This exposes data-to-image misassignment; the curated submission excludes figure assets and cannot build the report.

disqualification_flags.evidence: All 16 report Mach/pressure PNGs reproduce byte-for-byte from original case VTUs using make_figures.py:180–193, whose grouped quad-triangle ordering conflicts with adjacent duplicated cell values. M2 inviscid Mach misassigns 20126/20128 quad triangles (mean absolute error 0.5394). Re200 report vorticity PNG SHA256 5e5f1ae907a51521a54381211043c74bf693df46e0ccbc104f006681a75e850c reproduces exactly; make_figures.py:135–161 indexes cell-centered Velocity by node ID and also misassigns triangles. This establishes specific embedded figure/data misrepresentation, not fabricated underlying fields.
